images.caption: From left to right, Cambodian Major General Pen Ra, U.S. Navy Capt. Jim Morgan, Sihanouk province Deputy Governor Prack Chansokha and U.S. Navy Rear Adm. Kate Gregory cut a ribbon during a ribbon cutting ceremony at The O Chrov Health Center in Sihanoukville, Cambodia, Aug. 10, 2012, as part of Pacific Partnership 2012 (PP12). Pacific Partnership is an annual deployment of forces designed to strengthen maritime and humanitarian partnerships during disaster relief operations, while providing humanitarian, medical, dental and engineering assistance to nations of the Pacific. (DoD photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Michael Feddersen, U.S. Navy/Released)

images.caption: U.S. Navy Lt. Christopher Chung watches as Kong Bunho, a member of the Royal Cambodian Air Force, performs a dental procedure during a medical civic action project (MEDCAP) at Kandol Dom Primary School for Pacific Partnership 2012 in Sihanoukville, Cambodia, Aug. 3, 2012. MEDCAPs provide free medical, dental and optometry care to host nation patients and provide training and subject matter exchanges between the service members and civilians working on PP12 and the host nation medical personnel. Pacific Partnership is an annual deployment of forces designed to strengthen maritime and humanitarian partnerships during disaster relief operations, while providing humanitarian, medical, dental and engineering assistance to nations of the Pacific. (DoD photo by Kristopher Radder, U.S. Navy/Released)
